scope: Options > Controls: original CMenuControls rows, device tracking, unassign and scroll arrows over the input action layer, the controls.cfg persistence and the replacement on-screen touch controls; no LTGUI, console or DirectInput code imported

references.purpose: g_pControlActionName/g_nControlActionStringID order (42 actions, screen size rows commented out), column widths 100/11/20/100 with the action right-justified, small font, no spacing or wrap, arrows at x 298; MENU_CMD_CHANGE_CONTROL shows '=' and tracks keyboard, mouse and joystick buttons; HandleDeviceTrack ignores Tab, cancels on Escape, unbinds the control from its other action, replaces the action's control of the same device and binds; VK_DELETE unassigns every device; SetControlText joins devices with ' or ', MBUTTON n one-based, IDS_MENU_KEY_UNASSIGNED when empty.
RenderArrows: up arrow above the list (y - height - 8) when the start index is not zero, down arrow at list y + height - 5 while rows remain, centered on the UseArrows x, magenta transparency.
Options position (180, 140), menu height 280, UpArrow.pcx/DownArrow.pcx surfaces, the controls menu's Options parent.
IDS_MENU_ACTION_FORWARD..WEAPON9 (705-748) and IDS_MENU_KEY_UNASSIGNED (749); the strings themselves stay in the user's cres.dll.
COMMAND_RUNLOCK toggles CDATA_RUNLOCK (always run): distinct from the action layer's run latch, so the RunLock row stays disabled.

installed_data: defaults.cfg binds Weapon_0..Weapon_9 to DIK 2..11 (keys 1..9, 0): Weapon_0 maps to weapon slot 1.
adaptations: Rows map original actions onto the existing InputAction table; Strafe, RunLock, TurnAround, DropWeapon, Grab, Message, Taunt, MouseAimToggle and Crosshair have no port and are disabled.
Six replacement rows (Run Latch, Flashlight, Medkit, Binoculars, Night Goggles, The Eye) and a Restore Defaults row follow the original list.
Menu, menu navigation, quick save/load and analog look bindings are not rebindable; any Menu source (Esc, Start) cancels tracking and F5/F6 are ignored like Tab.

Backspace unassigns like Delete (the Mac delete key); gamepad controls are named PAD + console-layout names instead of J + DirectInput names; uncaptured mouse buttons and wheel ticks bind, touch-emulated clicks never do.
Bindings persist in controls.cfg (version 1, rebindable actions only) instead of the original console rangebind commands; a malformed file changes nothing.
On-screen touch controls are a replacement virtual gamepad with no original counterpart.
